== Biography ==
'''James Glasgow''' was born in 1819 in Pennsylvania, USA, son of [[Glasgow-664|John S. Glasgow Jr.]] (1777 - 1845) and [[Bell-17746|Elizabeth Jane (Bell) Glasgow]] (1774 - <1845).

James  married  '''Mary Elizabeth Dillen''' (1824–1845) in 1842)

James (~27) married [[Douglass-1765|'''Elizabeth R Douglass''']]  (~22)  in 1846. Their children were:
#[[Glasgow-668|Eliza E (Glasgow) Troxell]] (1847 - 1926)
#[[Glasgow-666|William E Glasgow]] (1852 - 1925).

James died on 17 Jun 1870<ref>
